page.notes: The page ends mid-word at "præ-" with the printed hyphen; the catchword "ficia-" is the continuation printed at the foot right. The long s has been normalised to s throughout, and the abbreviation "ferenif." is transcribed as "serenis." (long s as s). The parenthesis "(ut videl." is left unclosed as printed. Italic is marked where the type is clearly italic; some proper names may be roman in the original. Edges of the scan (right strip, dark marks at the left margin, small marks at the foot) are not printed text and are omitted.
